entities.name: Domri Rade
entities.description: Young Gruul boy, future planeswalker, preparing for the Burying rite of passage.

entities.name: Whip
entities.description: Domri's best friend, a young Gruul.

entities.name: Lakkie
entities.description: Domri's best friend, a young Gruul skilled at binding glass, who is kind of Selesnyan.

entities.name: Sabast
entities.description: Gruul shaman who guides Domri through the Burying.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: Nature-aligned guild of Ravnica whose rite of passage is the Burying.

entities.name: Shard Blades
entities.description: Tribe name proposed by Domri for the three friends.

entities.name: Burying
entities.description: Secret Gruul rite of passage stripping away attachment to city life.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: Guild whose symbol was on the cathedral window; its developers claim the Utvara.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: Guild that Sabast says has deadened hearts and no passion for life.

entities.name: Rubblebelt
entities.description: Ruined region of Ravnica holding a ruined cathedral and dangerous beasts.

entities.name: Utvara
entities.description: Ruined area of Ravnica that is home to many Gruul.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: City plane described by the Gruul as a slave to rules.

events.summary: Domri hurls a stone through the cathedral's Orzhov window, and the friends make glass daggers.
Domri proposes calling their tribe the Shard Blades.
events.quote: We could call our tribe the Shard Blades,

events.summary: Walking back to camp, the friends discuss the coming Burying, which fills Domri with dread.
events.quote: I wonder what it's going to be like? You know, the Burying.

events.summary: Domri is dressed in burial garb and the tribe wails as if he had died; Sabast says the boy dies today.
events.quote: In one way or another, that boy dies today.

events.summary: Sabast leads Domri deep into the Utvara and explains the Gruul view of death and nature.
Sabast leads Domri through a hidden cave to a grave and declares it time for the false Domri to die and the real one to be born.
events.quote: It is time for the false you to die.

relations.quote: His best friends, Whip and Lakkie, stood alongside him
